basic_details.job_title: ISRO URSC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 410 Posts
basic_details.organization_name: U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), ISRO, Department of Space

qualification.details: Only candidates who have passed out in the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible to apply. Candidates who cleared their qualifying examination before 2021 are not eligible. Only those who completed the qualifying examination as regular candidates can apply - candidates with sandwich course, certificate, private college degree, or short-term/certificate course qualifications are not acceptable, and candidates currently pursuing higher studies are also not eligible.

salary_details.details: Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend as per their stream: ₹12,300/- per month for Graduate Apprentices (B.E./B.Tech.), and ₹10,900/- per month for both Technician Apprentices (Diploma) and Commercial Practice Apprentices.

selection_process: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their percentage of marks in the respective discipline Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification On successful completion of document verification

a panel will be drawn based on academic scores in the Degree/Diploma Induction of apprentices against vacant positions will be made strictly based on the candidate's position in the panel Selected candidates will be informed only through email Candidates shortlisted for document verification are not eligible for Travelling Allowance
how_to_apply: Visit the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and register/enroll as a candidate
Upload the Degree/Diploma certificate (as applicable) and a valid government-issued ID during enrolment
Note the Enrolment Number/Apprenticeship Registration Number generated after successful registration on the NATS portal
Visit the UMANG portal at https://web.umang.gov.in/landing/ and register/log in
Search for "URSC Apprenticeship" on the UMANG portal
Click on Apply for Position and fill in all the required details, compulsorily including the NATS Enrolment Number/Apprenticeship Registration Number
Upload the required documents (photograph, signature, certificates, caste/EWS/disability certificate as applicable)
Review all entered details carefully, since no changes are allowed once the application is submitted
Submit the application before the closing date, 28 August 2026 (11:59 Hrs)
important_instructions: Use a valid and active email ID for registration; this email will be used for all future communication, and only one application can be submitted per email ID - duplicate applications from multiple email IDs should be avoided In case of multiple/duplicate applications for the same discipline, only the latest application will be considered The aggregate marks in B.E./B.Tech./Diploma must be entered either as CGPA or percentage, exactly as given in the consolidated mark list, and must be verifiable from the uploaded certificates - any discrepancy at any stage will lead to disqualification Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply Candidates must produce all relevant original documents (proof of date of birth, mark sheets, testimonials, and educational certificates) at the time of document verification, failing which they will not be considered for apprenticeship Candidates will have to make their own arrangements and bear all expenses for lodging and boarding during document verification No interim correspondence will be entertained, and canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification At the time of joining, original certificates will be verified; any mismatch with the online application data will result in summary rejection of candidature URSC reserves the right to cancel or alter the number of vacancies in a particular discipline, or the entire apprentice engagement process, without assigning any reason Any information/corrigendum/addendum related to this notification will be published only on the ISRO/URSC website - candidates are advised to check it regularly In case of any ambiguity or dispute in interpreting the Hindi version of the notification, the instructions in the English version will be treated as final The Government encourages women and transgender candidates to apply, in line with its effort to maintain gender balance in the workforce

Candidates who have completed their B.E./B.Tech. or Diploma in Engineering can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and ISRO Recruitment 2026 notifications. Those holding a Diploma in Commercial Practice can browse more Diploma Government Jobs matching their qualification. Applicants looking for openings closer to Bengaluru can also check Karnataka Government Jobs across various departments, and candidates open to apprenticeship roles nationwide can explore more Apprentice Jobs 2026 and PSU Apprenticeship Jobs currently open across India.

rows.details: U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), ISRO, Department of Space

content_sections.heading: URSC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: No other dates such as document verification schedule or panel announcement have been specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: URSC Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Out
content_sections.text: A total of 410 apprentice posts are available across three categories. The Graduate stream (B.E./B.Tech.) has 220 posts, the Technician stream (Diploma) has 120 posts, and the Commercial Practice stream has 70 posts. Category-wise breakup for Graduate Apprenticeship (total 220): SC-31, ST-14, OBC-59, EWS-22, UR-94. Category-wise breakup for Technician Apprenticeship (total 120): SC-17, ST-8, OBC-30, EWS-12, UR-53.

tables.caption: C. Apprenticeship for Commercial Practice - 70 Posts

content_sections.heading: URSC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only candidates who have passed out in the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible to apply. Candidates who cleared their qualifying examination before 2021 are not eligible. Only those who completed the qualifying examination as regular candidates can apply - candidates with sandwich course, certificate, private college degree, or short-term/certificate course qualifications are not acceptable, and candidates currently pursuing higher studies are also not eligible.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in the concerned discipline from any recognized University
Diploma in the respective discipline from a recognized State Board
Diploma in Commercial Practice from a recognized Board

content_sections.heading: URSC Apprentice 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend as per their stream: ₹12,300/- per month for Graduate Apprentices (B.E./B.Tech.), and ₹10,900/- per month for both Technician Apprentices (Diploma) and Commercial Practice Apprentices.

content_sections.heading: URSC Apprentice 2026 - Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: These are engagement terms for a fixed-duration apprenticeship and do not constitute regular employment with URSC or ISRO.

rows.details: 12 months from the date of execution of the Apprenticeship contract

Candidates who have already completed or are undergoing apprenticeship elsewhere, or have 1 year or more of experience with any institution, or have been terminated/resigned from apprenticeship training, are not eligible
Selected candidates must submit a Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of joining
Trainees have no claim whatsoever to employment at URSC or any other ISRO/Department of Space centre after completion of training

content_sections.heading: URSC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their percentage of marks in the respective discipline Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification On successful completion of document verification, a panel will be drawn based on academic scores in the Degree/Diploma Induction of apprentices against vacant positions will be made strictly based on the candidate's position in the panel Selected candidates will be informed only through email Candidates shortlisted for document verification are not eligible for Travelling Allowance

content_sections.heading: URSC Apprentice 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Degree/Diploma Certificate or Provisional/Passing Certificate (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 1 MB) Marks certificates of all semesters/years combined in a single file (max 1 MB) Scanned photograph (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 50 KB), clear enough for identification Scanned signature (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 50 KB), clear and legible Latest caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, issued by the Competent Authority (max 50 KB) Disability certificate issued by the Competent Authority, for PwBD candidates Income and Assets Certificate valid for 2025-2026, in the prescribed EWS format, for EWS candidates (if applicable) Valid government-issued identity proof Aadhaar number seeded with bank account and enabled for DBT payment

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in URSC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: URSC has announced a total of 410 apprentice vacancies for 2026-27: 220 under Graduate Apprenticeship, 120 under Technician Apprenticeship, and 70 under Commercial Practice Apprenticeship.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for URSC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online registration closes on 28 August 2026 at 11:59 Hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for URSC Apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech. in the concerned discipline for the Graduate stream, a Diploma in the respective discipline for the Technician stream, or a Diploma in Commercial Practice for the Commercial Practice stream, from a recognized University/Board.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly stipend for URSC Apprentices?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices will receive ₹12,300/- per month, while Technician and Commercial Practice Apprentices will receive ₹10,900/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for URSC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) and then apply through the UMANG portal (https://web.umang.gov.in/landing/) by searching for "URSC Apprenticeship."

faq.question: Q6. Which candidates are eligible to apply based on year of passing?
faq.answer: Only candidates who passed their qualifying examination in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 as regular candidates are eligible. Those who passed before 2021 are not eligible.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the URSC Apprenticeship training?
faq.answer: The training period is 12 months, commencing from the date of execution of the Apprenticeship contract.
